extension.author: Dimitris Grammatikogiannis
extension.license: GNU General Public License version 2 or later;
extension.description: Jail users to their own folder (images/users/username).

field.name: jail_usergroups
field.label: Jail User Groups
field.description: Select the user groups that will be jailed.

field.name: allowed_usergroups
field.label: Allowed User Groups
field.description: Select the user groups that will never be jailed.

field.name: mask_usernames
field.label: Mask User Names
field.description: If checked, the user names will be masked. Changing this setting breaks existing URLs!

field.name: storage_path
field.label: Default storage path
field.description: The storage path for the User content. Changing this setting breaks existing URLs!

field.name: storage_folder
field.label: Folder name
field.description: The folder where user content will be stored. By default, a 'users' folder will be created and used if this option is left blank. Changing this setting breaks existing URLs!

field.name: storage_name
field.label: Display name
field.description: The display name of the provider.
